item.tib: spyi 'dul yi dam rgya mtsho'i snang srid yongs rdzogs kyi skong ba
item.coloph: zhi khro yongs rdzogs kyi skong ba/ gsang ba 'dus pas tshig dang yi ger bkod/ de nas dbal bon gyis zhus/ de nas rim gyis brgyud de/ dran pa nam mkha' yis brag seng ge 'dra ba la sbas/ rgya rgya rgya/ sprul sku kyu ra rnal 'byor gyis pom ra'i g.yas zur nas bton//
